domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers the core principles of ONTAP data management, focusing on how data is organized, stored, and accessed within the cluster environment to ensure efficient operations and high availability for all enterprise storage resources.

This domain addresses the structural design of storage systems, including hardware configurations, high-availability pairs, and overall cluster architecture to provide a foundation for managing complex data environments and ensuring consistent system performance.

This domain focuses on the configuration and management of SAN and NAS protocols to ensure reliable client access to storage resources, covering the necessary steps for protocol setup and effective LUN and file management.

This domain covers data protection strategies, including the use of SnapVault and other replication methods to ensure data availability and recovery, focusing on the implementation of data protection policies and reliable replication workflows.

This domain explores the integration of ONTAP storage with public cloud providers, specifically AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, focusing on cloud integration methods and the management of hybrid cloud storage solutions for modern enterprises.

This domain involves monitoring system performance and applying troubleshooting techniques to resolve issues within the ONTAP storage environment, ensuring that administrators can maintain optimal system health and resolve performance bottlenecks through effective monitoring workflows.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: The exam is a linear, fixed-form test delivered via Pearson VUE. It consists of multiple choice and multiple response questions. Manage your time effectively across all six domains to ensure you address every section before the time expires during your session.

faq.answer_text: The exam format is linear and fixed-form, consisting of multiple choice and multiple response questions. Specific question counts are not provided in the official documentation, so candidates should focus on mastering all six domains to ensure preparation for the test.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: The exam uses a scaled score system to evaluate candidate performance. The passing requirement is approximately 70%. Candidates should aim for high proficiency across all domains to ensure they meet this threshold and successfully achieve their certification status.

The registration price for this exam is 250 dollars. This fee covers the cost of the exam delivery through Pearson VUE. Candidates should ensure they are fully prepared before scheduling their appointment to maximize the value of their investment in this professional certification.
faq.question_title: How much does the exam cost?

faq.answer_text: The certification is valid for 2 years from the date of passing. After this period, a renewal is required to maintain your status. Keeping your certification current ensures that your skills remain aligned with the latest NetApp ONTAP technologies and industry best practices.

methodology.summary: This index was built by aggregating official NetApp documentation and third-party exam guides to provide a structured overview of the certification requirements and domain objectives for all prospective candidates seeking to validate their storage administration skills.

editorial.overview: The NetApp Certified Professional ONTAP exam, administered by NetApp, evaluates technical proficiency in managing complex ONTAP storage environments. It covers six distinct domains, including data management, storage architecture, SAN/NAS configuration, data protection, cloud integration, and performance troubleshooting. This certification confirms an individual's ability to implement and manage storage solutions effectively within NetApp ecosystems, ensuring they meet industry standards for storage administration, infrastructure design, and reliable data handling in modern enterprise environments.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the official NetApp study documentation and exam guides to understand the six domains. Focus on practical configuration tasks for SAN/NAS and data protection. Use the provided resources to practice cluster setup and management workflows. Ensure you are familiar with the specific features of ONTAP versions mentioned in the documentation. Consistent hands-on practice with the CLI and System Manager is necessary for success. Candidates should dedicate time to mastering the nuances of cluster storage management and replication policies to ensure readiness for the exam.
skills_summary: Cloud integration for AWS, Azure, and GCP
editorial.who_should_take: This exam targets storage administrators and architects with significant experience in NetApp ONTAP environments. Candidates should possess practical knowledge of storage configuration, data protection workflows, and cloud integration to successfully manage, maintain, and troubleshoot storage systems in demanding enterprise settings.

exam_rules: No personal items, notes, or reference materials permitted. Online proctored via Pearson VUE OnVUE: must be alone in room, no second monitors. All candidates must accept the NetApp Certification Program Agreement before scheduling.
id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID required. Name on ID must match registration exactly.

official_study_resources.notes: Exam objectives and preparation guides available on the official certification page.
official_study_resources.title: NetApp Certification Exam Preparation

official_study_resources.notes: Official instructor-led and self-paced courses aligned to certification tracks.
official_study_resources.title: NetApp Learning Center

passing_score_scale: Scaled score; approximately 70% passing for most exams
renewal_options: Certifications are valid for 2 years. Recertification requires passing the current version of the same exam or a higher-level exam in the same track before expiration. NetApp does not currently offer maintenance exams separate from the full exam.

retake_policy.notes: 14-day waiting period between failed attempts. Full exam fee applies for each retake attempt. Candidates who pass may not retake the exam to improve their score.

testing_centers.notes: All NetApp exams are delivered exclusively through Pearson VUE. Online proctored (OnVUE) and test center options both available.
